setup: The strings have length \([[length]]\) over an alphabet of \([[letters]]\) letters, one of which is \(a\).

steps.say: Counting the complement, the strings with no \(a\): each position may use only the other \([[letters]] - 1\) letters, so there are \(([[letters]]-1)^{[[length]]} = [[none]]\).
The wanted strings are the rest: \([[total]] - [[none]] = [[value]]\).
